## Scope

This project may include or depend on the following third-party components:

- Microsoft .NET and ASP.NET Core libraries

The associated license terms for those packages are governed by the upstream projects and package managers that distribute them. Please refer to the relevant package metadata, lock files, and upstream repositories for exact attribution and license details.
